title: How Culture Cultivates Commerce and Brand Discovery
summary: Amazon's Camille Nordby shared how consumers engage with culture and how brands tap into notable moments to foster brand discovery.

extraction.key_fact: Amazon이 소비자의 문화 소비 방식과 브랜드가 이를 활용해 발견성을 높이는 방법을 소개했다.
extraction.key_fact_quote: Amazon's Camille Nordby shared how consumers engage with culture and how brands tap into notable moments to foster brand discovery.
